---
title: "map"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ggspatial)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(rnaturalearthhires)
library(sf)
library(ggrepel)
```

```{r setup-dirs}
# Creates the figures/ folder this script writes to, if it doesn't already
# exist, so the script runs on a fresh clone that only has data/ and
# scripts/ - ggsave() errors on a missing parent directory rather than
# creating one.
dir.create("../figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
```


```{r map-framework}
world <- ne_countries(scale = "large", returnclass = "sf")
```

```{r load-locations}
locs <- read_xlsx("../data/locations.xlsx")

xlims <- range(locs$Lon) + c(-10, 10)
ylims <- range(locs$Lat) + c(-10, 10)
```

```{r map-plot}
map1 <- ggplot(data = world) +
  geom_sf(col = "grey") +
  coord_sf(xlim = xlims, ylim = ylims,
           expand = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = locs,
             aes(x = Lon, y = Lat,
                 shape = Country),
             size = 3, col = "#08306B") +
  geom_label_repel(data = locs,
                  aes(x = Lon, y = Lat, 
                      label = str_wrap(Location, 22, whitespace_only = TRUE)),
                  segment.color = "black",
                  nudge_y = c(-2, -2.5, 1.5, 0, 0, 0),
                  nudge_x = c(0, 0, 0, 7.5, -10, 7.5),
                  size = 5, fill = NA, seed = 42,
                  min.segment.length = 0.25) +
  annotation_scale(location = "br", width_hint = 0.2,
                   text_cex = 1) +
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "br", which_north = "true", 
        pad_x = unit(0.15, "in"), pad_y = unit(0.5, "in"),
        height = unit(0.5, "in"), width = unit(0.4, "in"), 
        style = north_arrow_orienteering(text_size = 15, text_face = "bold")) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 5) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 25)) +
  labs(x = "Longitude",
       y = "Latitude")

map1

ggsave("../figures/figure_1.png", width = 25, height = 20, unit = "cm", dpi = 500)
```
